Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down nearly 50% and decaying as a leveraged ETF. SMH needs attention as a 'TRIM' at -10.47%. SPAL is a brand-new, very volatile leveraged ETF, already down over 36%; remember margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on SOXL's stop and consider cutting losses. Also, watch for continued strength in AI/robotics sentiment following the China IPO.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk in your leveraged positions while staying alert for opportunities in core tech.
plays: Respect SOXL's stop or consider cutting losses given its deep drawdown and leveraged decay.
Watch SMH's stop at 540 closely; it's flagged for a trim.
Consider MU as a new buy if you're looking to add to chips, with a scanner entry at 936.21-934.35 and stop at 927.43.
